name: Military Base (HQ)
description: Command centre and barracks: trains infantry of every kind, tanks and artillery, earns a little money and backs the front. Metal and fuel for training are taken from its own store (deliver more by truck). Lose all your bases and you are out.

name: Power Plant
description: Generates energy for your side's grid. Every building within 100 km of a power plant works 25% faster (housing earns 50% more). Select it to see its power lines.

name: Housing Block
description: Only inside a city your side holds, at most 10 per city. Citizens pay taxes (money) and enlist (people), shared between teammates. 50% more income on the power grid.

name: Ore Mine
description: Extracts ore into its own store. Truck the ore to a metal works.

name: Metal Works
description: Smelts ore into metal. Needs ore delivered into its store by truck; the metal it makes stays on site until trucked away.

name: Oil Refinery
description: Refines fuel (2.5/s) into its tank. Fuel trucks take it to filling stations, airfields and bases. Built in the Kremenchuk zone (Ukraine only) it makes 50% more.

name: Filling Station
description: Fuel depot (20,000). Vehicles within 8 km refuel here automatically; keep it supplied with a fuel truck. Never shown to the enemy.

name: Rail Hub
description: Logistics hub: every friendly building within 25 km produces 25% more. Uses energy.

name: Machine Factory
description: Builds pickups, trucks, fuel trucks and rescue crews. Metal and fuel come from its own store.

name: Warehouse
description: Stores metal, fuel and ore (up to 30,000 each) as a hub for delivery routes.

name: Trench Line
description: Cheap fortification. Friendly units and buildings within 6 km take less damage and the front is harder to push there. Several trenches covering the same spot do not add up: upgrade one instead (3 levels).

name: Bunker
description: Hardened position: strong damage reduction and front resistance within 8 km. Bunkers do not stack with each other (a bunker and a trench do): upgrade it instead (3 levels).

name: Signal Station
description: Radio and recon post. Reveals enemy units and buildings within 35 km through the fog of war. Uses energy.

name: Pontoon Crossing
description: Boats and pontoons on a river bank. Your ground units can cross the river within 6 km. Without it rivers are crossed only on road bridges.

name: Anti-Air Station
description: Shoots down enemy drones and aircraft within 14 km. Ground weapons do little damage to air targets. Uses energy.

name: Training Centre
description: Send ground units inside (select them, right click the centre). With at least 3 inside you can pay for a course: after the wait they come out one rank higher and at full strength. Holds 12.

name: Drone Factory
description: Builds your side's drones: strike drones that dive on a target and explode, and recon drones that circle an area. Built in the Alabuga zone (Russia only) it works 50% faster.

name: Missile Factory
description: Missile production line. Missiles are not in the game yet: this site is ready for a coming update.

name: Airfield
description: Base for recon drones: they refuel here (within 12 km) from its fuel tank (20,000). Sees 25 km.

name: Aircraft Plant
description: Factory for manned aircraft and helicopters. Not in the game yet: this site is ready for a coming update.
